name: Generic HTTP Tags Header
description: Exports the Purge-Cache-Tags response header to support tag-based invalidation. You only need this for custom setups under your own control.
project_description:
Synopsis 
 This project provides a generic HTTP-based purger to the Purge project and allows site builders to support caching platforms and CDNs that aren't supported by any other modules. It aims to provide the same technical configuration options that older versions of Purge provided.

 Requirements 
 Enable at least the purger and purger_ui modules, to be able to create a new purger through the UI.

 To create a new HTTP-based purger, visit the settings page over at /admin/config/development/performance/purge and click the Add purger button.
